name: 2,5-dimethoxy-4-fluoroamphetamine
summary: 2,5-Dimethoxy-4-fluoroamphetamine (DOF) is a serotonin receptor modulator and possible psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is taken orally. The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2015.

pharmacology.text: The receptor and transporter interactions of DOF have been characterized. As with other DOx drugs, it shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors and acts as a partial to full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptors. However, it shows much lower affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors than many other DOx drugs and a much lower degree of selectivity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor over the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Stimulant; Possible psychedelic drug
